import {Meta} from '@storybook/addon-docs/blocks'; import { version } from '/package.json'; # University of Iowa Design System (UIDS) The UIDS component library is a central repository of brand-approved components for use across websites and digital experiences—regardless of platform or chosen content-management system. All components make use of official brand colors, fonts, and graphic elements. You can read more at the Brand Manual website. ## Getting started

### Fonts Fonts are not included in the CSS files provide. You must include the code below into the `` of your html to have fonts render correctly. ``` ``` ### Use the full library Include the following CSS file in your project. It will include all UIDS components. - uids.css Refer to component pages for HTML examples. ### Use specific components Include the following CSS file in your project. It will include only the UIDS core styles. - uids-core.css For each component you would like to include, you will need to include the CSS file for that component as well. Refer to component pages for HTML examples.
